:::{#thm-wilks}

#### Wilks' theorem

Suppose the conditions of @thm-dist-mle hold,
and a null hypothesis $H_0$ imposes $q$ constraints on the parameter vector $\vth$.
Let $\hthml$ be the unrestricted MLE
and $\hat\th_0$ the MLE under $H_0$.
Then, if $H_0$ is true, as $n \to \infty$:

$$
\Lambda \eqdef 2\paren{\llik(\hthml) - \llik(\hat\th_0)}
\overset{d}{\to}
\chi^2_q
$$

:::

::: notes
Equivalently, in terms of nested models:
if a full model $M_1$ has $p$ free parameters,
and a nested model $M_0 \subset M_1$,
obtained by imposing $q$ constraints on $M_1$,
has $p_0 = p - q$ free parameters,
then when $M_0$ is true,
$\Lambda = 2\paren{\llik_{M_1}(\hthml) - \llik_{M_0}(\hat\th_0)}$
converges in distribution to $\chi^2_q$.
:::
